verdict.rationale: Make ships an official MCP server and 'Make AI Agents' app that let LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) run and manage scenarios via natural-language tool calls, plus 'Make Skills' markdown files to guide assistants — this is real agentic/NL operation support. However, this capability is mediated entirely through external AI clients rather than a built-in natural-language command interface in Make itself, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of a native in-product NL command bar/assistant, and third-party/hands-on validation of the MCP-driven workflow.
